arms.skip: skip syntactically unused lambda argument and let-value evaluation; preserve binder positions and all inference checks
arms.reuse: reuse a checked lambda body type when it is atomic and closed, as the codomain closure consumed by application; preserve dependent/open-body fallback

mechanism_tests: demand scaling unused/used lambda and let values with forced evaluation
reuse scaling of application to checked closed-atomic versus dependent body types
valid-to-invalid context poisoning, InferOnly-to-Check, local/global IDs and reset lifetime
library and retained export regression gates
cost_screen: Same generic x86-64 compiler/flags and frozen executables for instrumented instruction and uninstrumented CPU/RSS measurements. Two alternating four-arm rounds on exact 25131-declaration prefix. Each promoted arm must save >=1% against the matching baseline in both rounds and aggregate, beyond baseline control variation. Loop controls and complete ACCEPTs required.
attribution: Unchanged qualified original executable, exclusive compiled-symbol software instruction profile on exact prefix; inlining prevents interpreting symbol names as pure semantic cost shares.
transfer: Exact portable fixtures selected for lambda/let, projection, dependent contexts and recursors; full hosted 230 gate for surviving arms; complete Mathlib and other nine large cases only after a cost-screen survivor.
boundary: Semantic microtests and software profiles are bounded evidence, never an official Arena score. No previously rejected prototype or larger-session-budget change is combined.
noise_rule: Before candidate observations, run two intentional identical-executable baseline controls. Set the minimum reduction to max(1%, twice their fractional instruction-count range). This is a conservative screen, not a statistical confidence interval.
implementation_scope: Skip: direct syntactically erasing beta redex before eager right-argument flattening; unused lambda arguments reached through the ordinary spine; unused let values. Reuse: only atomic, closed body types already established by Check. All dependent/open types retain the original inference closure.
local_transfer_boundary: All selected original bug/tutorial cases up to 512 KiB plus selected let/projection performance cases and three generated warmed-universe controls. Local killed processes remain UNKNOWN; a hosted four-arm all-230 qualification resolves the portable boundary.
